Sandbox_NOX_EVO_B42_MutationBaseRate_too: Base amount of virus accumulated in the body every minute. Increasing this dramatically raises survival difficulty.
Sandbox_NOX_EVO_B42_ExpansionRate_toolti: The radius (in tiles) that the erosion expands per day.
Sandbox_NOX_EVO_B42_EnableMilestones_too: Enables point distribution and self-purification (Detox) based on survival days.
Sandbox_NOX_EVO_B42_AwakeningPoints_tool: Number of Evolution Points (EP) granted when mutation reaches 100%.
Sandbox_NOX_EVO_B42_MaxActiveScripts_too: Maximum number of zombies executing special AI simultaneously. Affects PC performance.
Sandbox_NOX_EVO_B42_DistanceCulling_tool: Distance from the player at which complex AI calculations are completely stopped。
Sandbox_NOX_EVO_B42_DaysToAirstrike_tool: Grace period until final purification (airstrike) by the military begins.
